dimensions.reasons: The static product scene is clearly a cosmetic pump bottle: Group B hero_still_frame001 shows a centered cyan cylindrical bottle with rounded shoulders, a metallic pump, blank front label, and studio backdrop in an appropriate slightly top-down three-quarter composition. However, the final Group C video samples remain effectively identical from frame_0001 through frame_0016, so the submitted exported animation does not visibly deliver the requested full turntable, despite the separately exported Group B frame set showing varied orientations.
issues: No visible rotation is evidenced in the sampled final animation frames.
The metal reads substantially darker and more chrome-like than the requested clean bright-silver pump.
The presentation is overly high-key relative to the request that the product not be washed out.

dimensions.reasons: Across Group A wide_front, wide_back, and side views, the bottle rests solidly on the studio floor and casts a consistent contact shadow. The collar, pump cylinder, and curved nozzle are visibly connected into a coherent assembly with no floating components.
issues: The label is visibly an extremely thin offset overlay in Group A detail_label, with a faint edge/gap rather than reading as fully adhered to the curved bottle.
The requested threaded 24/410 neck is not visibly modeled; the collar is ribbed, but no functional thread detail can be seen.

dimensions.reasons: The silhouette reads immediately as the intended pump-dispenser bottle in all overview views: it has a tall cylindrical frosted cyan body, tapered shoulder, narrow neck, ribbed collar, and a downward-curved dispensing nozzle. The blank white label area is also present and recognizably placed on the body.
issues: The pump appears dark chrome/black over much of its surface rather than predominantly bright silver.
The white label looks like a separate featureless decal with a visible edge, not a convincingly integrated label area.

dimensions.reasons: The designated author final, Group B hero_still_frame001, is cleanly rendered with a believable grounded product and coherent reflection/shadow behavior. Fine ribbing and brushed directional reflections are visible on the collar and pump in Group A detail_pump.
issues: Strong clipped white highlights and very dark reflections on the metal undermine the intended clean brushed-silver finish.
The body and label are low contrast against the high-key lighting, giving the image a washed-out appearance.
Rear and side views expose a dark rectangular form through the translucent body and the label edge, reducing the polish of the product render.

dimensions.reasons: The single bottle is appropriately centered, upright, and separated from distractions on a seamless studio floor. Group B hero_still_frame001 uses a useful elevated three-quarter view that exposes both body depth and the nozzle, while Group A multi-view renders confirm the pump, collar, body, and label remain in sensible relative positions.
issues: The Group A wide_left and wide_right evaluator views reveal intrusive black curved backdrop/off-frame geometry at the upper corners, showing that the surrounding staging is not robust from every angle.
The sampled final animation does not demonstrate the intended all-angle presentation.

dimensions.reasons: Visible ratios are sensible for a compact lotion bottle: the tall body is roughly several times its diameter, the neck is narrower than the body, and the collar and pump occupy a plausible portion of the total height. The label also occupies a believable lower-middle portion of the front body.
issues: Exact 40 mm, 105 mm, and 150 mm dimensions cannot be verified from the renders.
The collar appears somewhat visually heavy relative to the narrow neck and body.

dimensions.reasons: The author final uses the requested neutral gray-to-white studio background and a soft floor shadow. Group A detail views clearly show a pale cyan semi-translucent/frosted body, metallic ribbing, and directional brushing cues on the upper pump components.
issues: The lighting is too intense in several views, producing clipped highlights and low body/label separation.
The pump's dark mirror-like regions read more as chrome than bright brushed silver.
The body translucency exposes an undesirable dark internal/reverse-label shape in rear views rather than cleanly obscuring the interior.

dimensions.reasons: The static scene includes all main visible physical elements: one frosted cyan bottle body, rounded shoulder and neck, metal collar, pump head with a curved downward nozzle, blank white front label area, studio floor, and neutral gradient backdrop. No major requested physical object is absent.
issues: Visible thread detail for the specified 24/410 connection is absent or too obscured to verify.
The final sampled animation does not visibly provide the requested 360-degree loop, even though static product components are complete.

criteria.criterion: The bottle body must jointly satisfy its specified geometry, dimensions, shoulder transition, and complete frosted-glass appearance.
The neck, mounted collar, pump head, nozzle, metal response, closed state, and overall height must form one complete specified dispenser system.
The bottle front must provide the specified continuous and visibly blank label footprint.
The final animation must combine the specified soft studio environment with controlled product readability and separation.
criteria.evidence: The final MP4 samples (frame_0001 through frame_0016) show a clean gray-to-white seamless studio backdrop, broad soft illumination, and a grounded shadow. However, the product rendering is strongly high-key: the pump/collar have clipped white highlights and the pale-cyan body has low contrast against the bright floor/background, so material and component definition are partially washed out rather than consistently controlled across the delivered animation.

criteria.criterion: The actual animation camera must provide the specified perspective, slightly top-down three-quarter view, and resulting sense of depth.
The complete recognizable product must perform the required centered full-revolution turntable motion as a continuous constant-speed loop.
The actual video file must jointly satisfy the requested format, exact square resolution, duration, and effective frame rate.
The retained Blender project must be valid, editable, re-angleable, complete, and natively configured for the requested Cycles animation.

notes: A clearly recognizable, well-assembled lotion pump bottle is present with appropriate bottle geometry, cyan frosted appearance, label space, and studio composition. The principal shortcomings are washed-out/highly clipped product lighting, overly dark chrome-like pump surfaces, the thin detached-looking label, absent visible neck threading, and most importantly the lack of visible motion in the supplied final animation-frame sequence.
score_policy: Frozen paper score: uncapped 0.5 rubric + 0.5 dimension.
